description: A cricketer's career batting and bowling aggregates (matches, runs, average, strike rate, 100s/50s; wickets, bowling average, economy) from Cricsheet's Test/ODI/T20I/IPL match data. Pass a name or partial name ("Kohli", "V Kohli") -- Cricsheet stores short-form names, so this matches case-insensitively and returns a candidate list if the name is ambiguous. Optionally scope to one format with `format`. Covers only matches Cricsheet has scored ball-by-ball, not a player's entire career.

format.description: Match format: "Test", "ODI", "T20I" (international T20), or "IPL". Omit to search across every format this pack holds.

player.description: Player name or partial name, e.g. "Kohli" or "V Kohli".

name: cricsheet_player_stats
title: Cricsheet Player Stats
